correctness.rationale: The binary increment n->n+1 replaces M 0 1^t with M 1 0^t. The only lost occurrences are (t-k+1)_+ and the new leading occurrence is present iff the trailing-one count of M is >=k-1, yielding an exact parity transition criterion. For block [jH,(j+1)H), t<k transitions occur at (j+1)H-2^t-1 for t<=nu2(j+1), and the endpoint has the stated parity depending on the odd quotient. In-block gaps and v=nu2(j+2) classify every interblock gap. The elementary 2-adic residue densities then give every rational lambda_k and no hidden run types. Independently evaluated the original parity definition for 2^18 successive terms for k=2..7; all six spectra agree. Independently recomputed each rational frequency mass and length-weighted mass exactly for k=2..10; their sums equal Lambda_k and H. This verifies algebraic identities, not a finite substitute for the unbounded carry proof; boundary k=2 frequency collisions and n=0 initial run are accounted for.
